features.quote: Turn budget (`max_turns`, default 12). Bounds cost, and bounds the window in which a spiral can develop
features.justification_quote: Bounds cost ... short enough to run thousands of times cheaply

features.quote: The loop ends on explicit `give_up`, on an assistant turn with no tool calls (soft stop), on `max_turns`, or on an API error
`give_up` is an explicit tool ... "call this when the task is complete OR you've determined no further progress is possible"
features.justification_quote: turns abandonment into a *clean, countable signal*

features.quote: The agent's instructions truthfully state the tests are the spec ... We're not lying to it
features.justification_quote: we're holding it to the stated constraint
